answer: Each challenge is instantiated only after a drand quicknet pulse: its nonce is derived from the verified threshold-BLS signature and bound to the claimant’s commitment. A sybil swarm therefore cannot precompute valid answers or farm them offline before the unpredictable inputs exist. Commit-reveal checks expose withheld submissions without giving operators control over the pulse; relic, lagoon, and spiral can name task branches, while the beacon fixes which branch and parameters count.
